review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the frozen C input. REQ-001, AC-001–AC-003, repository identity/base commit, exact writable binding scopes, evidence stages and readiness agree with the original specification. C explicitly fixes OPT-1 as a hypothetical input without asserting a human Decision; an empty human-decision input is therefore consistent with ready. This does not waive the requirement that a material unresolved DEC-001 block paired B at decisions. The supplied source supports index.js and the separately maintained index.d.ts as implementation/declaration owners, with test.js and index.test-d.ts as regression scopes. limitFunction forwards the same clearQueue function and inherits its declaration through Pick, so no additional forwarding implementation edit is mandatory. package.json establishes separate runtime and type validation through xo && ava && tsd, without requiring configuration changes or claiming those checks have run. The two task roles, verification dependency and required dual AC coverage are explicit. The allowed implementer and verifier are distinct, auto-assignable members with available capacity and supplied active project-scoped trusted claims covering the relevant API, shared data/state, asynchronous consumer, language and testing capabilities; the verifier additionally has testing.verification. Pending security.authorization claims do not establish trusted authorization capability, but this bounded change supplies no corresponding required security impact. A separate active reviewer satisfies the stated non-executing review prerequisite. Source fingerprint differences are explained by the documented normalization and digest domains; Gold and preview release fingerprints and budgets agree. Original preparation-time remaining/null fields are supplemented by the frozen preview and provenance. Review relies on the supplied Service binding assertions, not independently recomputed digests, execution, new human attestation or candidate results. No material error or unresolved ambiguity was identified.
